# ADR-010: Separate standalone core acceptance from later Original Blue integration

Status: chosen_by_current_world_engine_instruction

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-interfaces, Q-evidence, Q-platforms

## Decision

Classify original obligations by source semantics as WORLD_CORE, HOST_ADAPTER, MIXED or UNKNOWN within the existing canonical queue. Split mixed fixtures into linked core and adapter obligations. Keep Blue-only requirements deferred with reasons; all unknown semantics and core proofs block core completion.

## Rationale

The active milestone requires all world semantics independently of legacy hosting. A stream fixture also observes world membership and transferred fields. Hosting failures cannot erase those assertions.

## Alternatives

Let missing Blue halt unrelated mechanics; classify every Blue import as an adapter obligation; create a separate world queue.

## Consequences

Core and full reports come from one inventory. Full remains incomplete for deferred adapters. Core remains incomplete for unknowns, missing feature/configuration extraction and required assurance/production evidence; current rejection checks do not claim a complete closure audit.
